LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_FIVE.learnerPromise: Say that something will happen soon.
LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_FIVE.explanation: Put 快, 快要 or 要 before the coming action. Always put 了 at the end of the sentence.
LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_FIVE.pattern: Subject + 快 / 快要 / 要 + event + 了

columns.meaning: marks a new or coming situation

patternRows.english: Our class is about to start.

text.traditional: 火車快要來了。
text.simplified: 火车快要来了。
text.pinyin: Huǒchē kuàiyào lái le.
text.english: The train is about to arrive.

words.meaning: marks a new or coming situation

text.traditional: 十月了，冬天快要到了。
text.simplified: 十月了，冬天快要到了。
text.pinyin: Shí yuè le, dōngtiān kuàiyào dào le.
text.english: It is October; winter is about to arrive.

text.pinyin: Xiànzài bā diǎn wǔshí fēn le, túshūguǎn kuài kāi le.

items.answer: Put 了 at the end, after the coming action.

right.english: The train is about to arrive.

items.answer: This pattern always ends with 了.

LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_FOUR.learnerPromise: Try an action and see how it goes.
LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_FOUR.explanation: Repeat a one-syllable action verb, then add 看: try the action and see.

patternRows.english: I will try it on and see.

text.traditional: A：我不知道要買哪種甜點。 B：你可以先吃吃看。
text.simplified: A：我不知道要买哪种甜点。 B：你可以先吃吃看。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ bù zhīdào yào mǎi nǎ zhǒng tiándiǎn. B: Nǐ kěyǐ xiān chī chi kàn.
text.english: A: I don’t know which kind of dessert to buy. B: You can try some first and see.

text.traditional: A：聽說這裡的咖啡很好喝。 B：好，我喝喝看。
text.simplified: A：听说这里的咖啡很好喝。 B：好，我喝喝看。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō zhèlǐ de kāfēi hěn hǎohē. B: Hǎo, wǒ hē he kàn.
text.english: A: I hear the coffee here tastes good. B: OK, I’ll try some and see.

words.meaning: links a description to a noun

text.traditional: A：我的錢包在你那裡嗎？ B：不在我這裡，你去客廳找找看。
text.simplified: A：我的钱包在你那里吗？ B：不在我这里，你去客厅找找看。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ de qiánbāo zài nǐ nàlǐ ma? B: Bú zài wǒ zhèlǐ, nǐ qù kètīng zhǎo zhao kàn.
text.english: A: Is my wallet with you? B: It isn’t here with me. Go and try looking for it in the living room.

words.meaning: links a description to a noun

items.question: Where does 看 go?
items.answer: Repeat the action verb first, then add 看.
items.wrongTraditional: 你可以先吃看吃。

right.traditional: A：我不知道要買哪種甜點。 B：你可以先吃吃看。

right.english: A: I don’t know which kind of dessert to buy. B: You can try some first and see.

items.answer: Repeat the action verb, such as 喝, then add 看.

LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_ONE.learnerPromise: Say what is pleasant or easy to do.
LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_ONE.explanation: 好 or 難 before a perception verb says something is pleasant or unpleasant. Before an action verb, it says something is easy or hard to do.

text.traditional: 這家餐廳的牛肉麵很好吃，我常吃。
text.simplified: 这家餐厅的牛肉面很好吃，我常吃。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, wǒ cháng chī.
text.english: The beef noodles is delicious from this restaurant; I have (it) often.

words.meaning: links a description to a noun

text.traditional: 這杯茶有點兒難喝，我不要喝。
text.simplified: 这杯茶有点儿难喝，我不要喝。
text.pinyin: Zhè bēi chá yǒu diǎnr nánhē, wǒ bú yào hē.
text.english: This cup of tea tastes a bit bad; I don’t want to drink it.

text.traditional: 這件衣服的顏色很好看，我很喜歡。
text.simplified: 这件衣服的颜色很好看，我很喜欢。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè hěn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
text.english: The color of this piece of clothing is good; I like it very much.

words.meaning: links a description to a noun

text.traditional: 你唱歌唱得很好聽，現在唱一首，好嗎？
text.simplified: 你唱歌唱得很好听，现在唱一首，好吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎotīng, xiànzài chàng yì shǒu, hǎo ma?
text.english: You sing very well. Can you do it now?

words.meaning: links an action to how well it is done

text.traditional: 這首中文歌很好唱，我朋友都會唱。
text.simplified: 这首中文歌很好唱，我朋友都会唱。
text.pinyin: Zhè shǒu Zhōngwén gē hěn hǎochàng, wǒ péngyǒu dōu huì chàng.
text.english: This Chinese song is easy to sing; all of my friends can sing it.

text.traditional: 弟弟不喜歡說英文，他覺得英文很難學。
text.simplified: 弟弟不喜欢说英文，他觉得英文很难学。
text.pinyin: Dìdi bù xǐhuān shuō Yīngwén, tā juéde Yīngwén hěn nánxué.
text.english: My younger brother doesn’t like to speak English; he thinks it is difficult to learn.

text.traditional: 這裡附近只有一家百貨公司，很好找。
text.simplified: 这里附近只有一家百货公司，很好找。
text.pinyin: Zhèlǐ fùjìn zhǐ yǒu yì jiā bǎihuò gōngsī, hěn hǎozhǎo.
text.english: There is only one department store in the vicinity, so it is easy to find.

text.traditional: 這輛腳踏車太小了，很難騎。
text.simplified: 这辆脚踏车太小了，很难骑。
text.pinyin: Zhè liàng jiǎotàchē tài xiǎo le, hěn nánqí.
text.english: This bike is too small; it is difficult to ride.

subsections.title: Pleasant or unpleasant
subsections.explanation: 好 or 難 describes the taste, appearance or sound.

subsections.title: Easy or difficult
subsections.explanation: 好 or 難 describes how easy or hard the action is.

items.question: Does 好 always mean easy?
items.answer: With a perception verb, it describes something pleasant.
items.wrongTraditional: 這家餐廳的牛肉麵很吃好，我常吃。
items.wrongSimplified: 这家餐厅的牛肉面很吃好，我常吃。

right.traditional: 這家餐廳的牛肉麵很好吃，我常吃。
right.simplified: 这家餐厅的牛肉面很好吃，我常吃。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, wǒ cháng chī.
right.english: The beef noodles is delicious from this restaurant; I have (it) often.

words.meaning: links a description to a noun

items.question: Where does 難 go?
items.answer: Put 難 before the action verb: 難學 means hard to learn.
items.wrongTraditional: 弟弟不喜歡說英文，他覺得英文很學難。
items.wrongSimplified: 弟弟不喜欢说英文，他觉得英文很学难。

right.traditional: 弟弟不喜歡說英文，他覺得英文很難學。
right.simplified: 弟弟不喜欢说英文，他觉得英文很难学。
right.pinyin: Dìdi bù xǐhuān shuō Yīngwén, tā juéde Yīngwén hěn nánxué.
right.english: My younger brother doesn’t like to speak English; he thinks it is difficult to learn.

LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_THREE.learnerPromise: Ask someone to confirm what you think.
LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_THREE.explanation: Put 吧 after a statement when you think it is true and want confirmation.

patternRows.english: You want to buy shoes, don’t you?

text.traditional: A：你會唱中文歌吧？ B：會。可是不多，我只會唱三首。
text.simplified: A：你会唱中文歌吧？ B：会。可是不多，我只会唱三首。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ huì chàng Zhōngwén gē ba? B: Huì. Kěshì bù duō, wǒ zhǐ huì chàng sān shǒu.
text.english: A: You can sing Chinese songs, right? B: Yes, but not many. I can only sing three.

text.traditional: A：他平常都坐捷運來上課吧？ B：不是，他都坐公車來上課。
text.simplified: A：他平常都坐捷运来上课吧？ B：不是，他都坐公车来上课。
text.pinyin: A: Tā píngcháng dōu zuò jiéyùn lái shàng kè ba? B: Bú shì, tā dōu zuò gōngchē lái shàng kè.
text.english: A: He usually comes to class by MRT, right? B: No, he always comes to class by bus.

text.traditional: A：你現在有空吧？要不要跟我一起去看網球比賽？ B：有空，可是我想先吃一點兒東西。
text.simplified: A：你现在有空吧？要不要跟我一起去看网球比赛？ B：有空，可是我想先吃一点儿东西。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ba? Yào bú yào gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù kàn wǎngqiú bǐsài? B: Yǒu kòng, kěshì wǒ xiǎng xiān chī yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
text.english: A: You’re free now, right? Would you like to watch a tennis match with me? B: I’m free, but I want to eat something first.

items.question: Where does 吧 go?
items.answer: Put 吧 after the statement you want confirmed.
items.wrongTraditional: 你吧會唱中文歌？
items.wrongSimplified: 你吧会唱中文歌？

right.traditional: A：你會唱中文歌吧？ B：會。可是不多，我只會唱三首。
right.simplified: A：你会唱中文歌吧？ B：会。可是不多，我只会唱三首。
right.pinyin: A: Nǐ huì chàng Zhōngwén gē ba? B: Huì. Kěshì bù duō, wǒ zhǐ huì chàng sān shǒu.
right.english: A: You can sing Chinese songs, right? B: Yes, but not many. I can only sing three.

items.question: Does 吧 guarantee a yes?
items.answer: No. It checks an assumption; the other person can correct it.
items.wrongTraditional: 他平常吧都坐捷運來上課？
items.wrongSimplified: 他平常吧都坐捷运来上课？

right.traditional: A：他平常都坐捷運來上課吧？ B：不是，他都坐公車來上課。
right.simplified: A：他平常都坐捷运来上课吧？ B：不是，他都坐公车来上课。
right.pinyin: A: Tā píngcháng dōu zuò jiéyùn lái shàng kè ba? B: Bú shì, tā dōu zuò gōngchē lái shàng kè.
right.english: A: He usually comes to class by MRT, right? B: No, he always comes to class by bus.

LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_TWO.learnerPromise: Give a reason and its result.
LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_TWO.explanation: 因為 introduces the reason; 所以 introduces the result. The reason usually comes first.
LESSON_EIGHT_GRAMMAR_TWO.pattern: 因為 + reason, 所以 + result

patternRows.english: Because this is a very famous brand and its clothes are beautiful, many people like it.

text.traditional: A：你為什麼不想走路到學校去？ B：因為學校很遠，所以我不想走路到學校去。
text.simplified: A：你为什么不想走路到学校去？ B：因为学校很远，所以我不想走路到学校去。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ wèishénme bù xiǎng zǒu lù dào xuéxiào qù? B: Yīnwèi xuéxiào hěn yuǎn, suǒyǐ wǒ bù xiǎng zǒu lù dào xuéxiào qù.
text.english: A: Why don’t you want to walk to school? B: Because school is far away, I don’t want to walk there.

text.traditional: A：為什麼你的朋友不跟你來？ B：因為他很累，所以他要在家休息。
text.simplified: A：为什么你的朋友不跟你来？ B：因为他很累，所以他要在家休息。
text.pinyin: A: Wèishénme nǐ de péngyǒu bù gēn nǐ lái? B: Yīnwèi tā hěn lèi, suǒyǐ tā yào zài jiā xiūxí.
text.english: A: Why isn’t your friend coming with you? B: Because he is tired, he wants to rest at home.

words.meaning: links a description to a noun

text.traditional: A：你為什麼今天一定要去百貨公司？ B：因為明天是我弟弟的生日，所以我要去買他的生日禮物。

subsections.title: Easy or difficult

items.question: Does 好 always mean easy?
items.answer: With a perception verb, it describes something pleasant.

items.question: Where does 吧 go?

right.traditional: A：你會唱中文歌吧？ B：會。可是不多，我只會唱三首。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something will happen soon.
